purpose: Evaluate the deployed balanced rule at realistic capital before proposing another sleeve; not optimize or promote a replacement.
costs: Primary fixed-style proxy: $0.005/share, $1 minimum; existing per-symbol spread and trailing-ADV impact. Also declared tiered proxy and doubled fixed costs. Actual historical broker fees/quotes are not known.
cash: Zero interest on positive idle cash, no margin or shorting; BIL distributions embedded in adjusted prices. DGS3MO only benchmarks excess returns.
window_accounting: One continuous replay per variant from January 2005, including real startup ramp. Subwindows include preceding NAV close as return denominator; no capital reset or retroactive parameter fit.

uncertainty.method: Paired circular block bootstrap of balanced-minus-comparator excess Sharpe, total-return volatility denominator. Sensitivity to block length is diagnostic, not independent confirmation.

exposure: Report mean marked weights, sleeve return correlation, and descriptive in-sample OLS of balanced excess returns on SPY/IEF excess returns. Regression is not a trading rule, causal explanation or proof of alpha.
interpretation: No pristine holdout, no target-Sharpe pass/fail or selection of best neighbor. Report full configurations, failures, costs, drawdown depth/duration and uncertainty. No paper allocation change.
limitations: Adjusted historical prices, whole-share research proxy, not raw corporate-action accounting
USD pretax; no CAD FX, XEQT, account-specific taxes or withholding
No historical borrow or live execution validation
Original data/universe selection and prior research reuse remain
Research engine replay, not an exact replay of production outages, reconciliation or risk-limit interventions
Zero idle cash interest is conservative, not a model of all broker account remuneration
No balanced-wide parameter search, nested walk-forward or effective multiple-testing probability
